vignette: A child with compromised immunity is scheduled for an invasive dental procedure. The dental team is deciding how to approach antibiotic prophylaxis.

options.text: Consult the child's physician about management and decide on prophylaxis for this individual patient.
Give prophylactic antibiotics routinely to every patient with special health care needs.
Withhold prophylaxis from all patients, including those at high risk of adverse outcomes from bacteremia.
Proceed on the dentist's judgment alone without involving the physician.
